name: Famima!
source:
Yuuji had been living by himself for a month. Just when he was starting to feel lonely, a girl comes to his house and tells him that she’s his imouto from a past life! The other girls accompanying her explain that he used to be a maou, and they all decide to live in his house.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
悠司獨自生活已經一個月。就在他開始感到寂寞時，一名女孩來到家中，聲稱自己是他前世的妹妹！與她同行的其他女孩解釋說，悠司前世曾是魔王。到頭來，女孩們全都決定搬進他家。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
